answer: Agents selling ember alerts, harbor forecasts, or oasis water reports must each lock a $100 bond in a contract for 30 days before accepting work. The contract allows only one open job per bonded identity. Creating more names therefore creates no free capacity: an attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous job slots must lock $100,000. This does not eliminate sybils, but ties their influence to scarce capital rather than cheap accounts.
